blocks.text: INGLEWOOD, California — Los Angeles Clippers guard Max Strus is out for at least a month with a right foot injury. The team said he suffered a partial tear of the plantar fascia in Sunday’s 104-101 win over the Golden State Warriors in the teams’ preseason opener in Hawaii. He’ll be reevaluated in four weeks. Strus joins forward Brandon Ingram (Achilles tendon) as new Clippers players who will be sidelined initially. The Clippers open the season on Oct. 21 at home against Sacramento.
